column1: # Who runs what. The one place that says it.
# FLEET REWRITE (2026-08-07, ch-dev): this manifest now describes the Group_GY DSW
# fleet -- seven 8xH100 boxes with ONE shared filesystem (/mgfs, verified by
# write-here-read-there) -- not the original m1-m3+cornell layout. The original
# cluster's completed runs (vanilla_s0, c1_lsm, on A100s) are NOT carried over:
# different silicon is already a registered deviation (PROTOCOL-unified §2.5), and
# every verdict wants arms and noise floor measured in ONE batch. Everything runs
# fresh here, under one fingerprint family.
# Columns:  wave  machine  arm  seed  [note]
#   wave     runs in ascending order; a machine finishes its wave-N list before N+1
#   machine  m1=dsw251  m2=dsw252  m3=dsw253  m4=dsw254   (8xH100 each, 4 lanes)
#            registered in .campaign/MACHINE_MAP via `MACHINE=<name> bash deploy/up.sh`.
#            dsw258/261/262 are deliberately held back: free for evals,
#            informativeness, D6 probes -- anything ad-hoc -- without competing with
#            campaign lanes. Enlist one by registering it (m5...) and adding rows.
#   arm      a run_id from configs/arms.yaml
#   seed     data.seed and rollout.seed
# deploy/campaign.sh --plan audits this against the registry: every runnable arm must
# appear exactly once, and it reports any that do not.
# ROLLOUT_GPU_MEM_UTIL is pinned to 0.45 for the WHOLE campaign by campaign.sh, not
# per row. One value = one batch = one noise floor shared by every arm.
# a1_gkd_mix0.5 is deliberately absent -- registry status 'needs'. Interleaving
# teacher-generated responses lands inside the TransferQueue agent loop, which is
# trainer surgery, and a2_coldstart already gives axis A an off-policy arm.
# ---- wave 1: the whole Phase-1 screen at once ---------------------------------
# 16 runs over 16 lanes, four boxes. m1 carries all three vanilla seeds -- THE noise
# floor, every verdict's denominator -- so the reference and its spread come from one
# box and any machine effect rides on the arms, not on the floor.

column1: # ---- wave 3: blocked until its prerequisite exists ----------------------------
# needs= is checked before the row is ever handed to a lane. The path is still the
# Cornell one because arms.yaml's env for this arm is too (STUDENT_MODEL, DATA_DIR):
# running it here means building the coldstart SFT ckpt on THIS fleet and re-pointing
# both -- an arms.yaml edit, i.e. a pin move with a REASON in PIN_HISTORY.
# ---- wave 4: merged from main 2026-08-07, NOT yet assigned --------------------
# Three arms and one model-pair cell arrived with the merge. None is given a machine
# here: wave 1 owns all sixteen lanes until it drains, and each of these has a
# prerequisite that is not met on this fleet. Listed so the manifest stays the whole
# truth rather than the part that happens to be runnable.
#   b3_eopd_gate    B axis, adaptive member: routes per token between b1's reverse KL
#                   (where the teacher is confident) and b2's forward KL (where it is
#                   spread). Runnable as-is -- same pair, same protocol, stock status.
#                   Worth running early: b2 collapsed to 0.002 by step 225 in wave 1,
#                   and b3 uses forward KL only where b2 uses it everywhere.
#   i0_think_scorer I axis (new), vanilla with the scorer swapped to
#   i1_priv_cot     Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. BLOCKED: that model is not in the shared
#                   HF cache and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 is fleet-wide (the 429 that killed
#                   all sixteen first-launch lanes is why). i1 additionally needs a
#                   precomputed think-block parquet that does not exist here, and its
#                   path is /mnt/workspace/... -- registry status is 'needs'.
#                   Before running either: Qwen3's template renders an assistant turn
#                   differently depending on whether it is the LAST message (<think>
#                   present vs stripped, measured 2026-08-07). Both arms turn on where
#                   the think block sits in the scored sequence, so verify that first.
#   W wave          NOT an arm: a second teacher-student pair, Qwen3-8B-Base <- 32B,
#                   running THESE arms under THIS protocol (docs/SimOPD-plan.md 6.5).
#                   BLOCKED twice over here: neither model is in the cache, and an 8B
#                   actor does not fit one card -- plan says 4-6 GPUs per lane against
#                   the 2 this fleet's rows assume, so a machine holds 1-2 W lanes,
#                   not 4. Needs its own in-cell vanilla; first batch is vanilla x2.
